sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head medium brown, oval, flat on top. Antennae 18-segmented, compound eyes rather large, black, 0.22 mm from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli rather large, contiguous with the compound eyes. Pronotum wider than the head, anterior margin concave, posterior margin weakly concave; sides rounded, not narrowed posteriorly; pronotum concolorous with the head. Each tibia with 3 large spines at the apex, the spine tips dark; tibiae darker than the femora; tarsi without arolia. Wings with the characters of the subgenus Neotermes: the basal third chitinized and dark, the outer two-thirds hyaline; costa, radius and media pale, cubitus almost invisible, media bent near the base. Body length with wings 13.70 mm; body length (without wings) 9.00 mm; head length 2.20 mm; head width 1.78 mm; antennal length 2.55 mm; compound eye diameter 0.55 mm; pronotal length 1.00 mm, width 2.00 mm; hind tibia length 1.33 mm; forewing length 10.28 mm, width 2.78 mm.
